sources.title: Sovereign Large Language Models: Advantages, Strategy and Regulations
sources.snippet: The authors primarily looked at high and middle-income countries, their independent approaches to creating sovereign large language models and AI development in general, and international cooperation programs between them. More than 18 macroregions were analyzed, covering about 85% of the world's population.
